scripts.dev: concurrently -n shared,api,web -c yellow,cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace @wanpanel/shared" "npm run dev --workspace @wanpanel/api" "npm run dev --workspace @wanpanel/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @wanpanel/shared && npm run build --workspace @wanpanel/api && npm run build --workspace @wanpanel/web
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @wanpanel/shared && npm run test --workspace @wanpanel/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @wanpanel/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @wanpanel/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @wanpanel/web
